name: project-brain
description: Git-native project memory, UI/Backend quality enforcement, task complexity scoring, CLI agent discovery, quota management, and sub-agent delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, verify, review, and resume projects with quota-aware CLI workers
interface.longDescription: Project Brain 3.2 keeps a project’s state in the repository: verified architecture, user-owned goal, Design System & Clean Architecture ADRs, and prioritized executable tasks. A stdlib Python runtime scores task complexity (Tier L/M/H), discovers installed CLI coding agents (Codex, Claude, OpenCode, Antigravity, OmniRoute, Qwen, ZCode), auto-starts local OmniRoute gateway when needed, reads live subscription quotas with 10%/25% reserve floors, delegates Tier L/M tasks to low/medium-effort workers inside ProcessTree, and binds checks, UI Triad evidence, and independent reviews to source/contract digests.
defaultPrompt: Set up Project Brain for this repository
Continue where the last session stopped
Scan CLI agents and delegate ready tasks
